meta.title: Embed Images in Article Text
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Embed Images in Article Text".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Embed Images in Article Text', 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text', '

In this tour you put images in the text of an article: one with a caption, one in a list, one in a table and one with a border.

The tutorial uses three images of the Crab Nebula, the Orion Nebula and the Hubble Space Telescope. Download them from the tutorial to upload them. No images at hand? Every Joomla site has some space images in the folder sampledata › cassiopeia: the tour tells you when to use them.

This tour follows the tutorial 4.1 Embedding Images in Article Text of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_categories","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 4.1 Embedding Images in Article Text', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Content › Categories', '

Click Categories in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'A category for the article', '

First you make a category Astronomy. Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-categories .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Category title', '

Type the title:

Astronomy

Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-category #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Save the category', '

Click Save & Close.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-category #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 6, 'right', 'body.com_categories.view-categories #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'A new article', '

Click New.

', 7, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Article title', '

Type the title:

Crab Nebula

Then click Next.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Category', '

Choose the category Astronomy. Then click Next.

', 9, 'left', '.view-article fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_catid)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'A media folder and the images', '

Click in the text area, then in the editor\'s menu CMS Content › Media. A window opens with your media. In that window:

  1. Click Create New Folder, type Astronomy and click Create.
  2. Click the new folder Astronomy in the tree on the left.
  3. Upload the three images: drag them into the window, or click Upload.

This media folder is not the same thing as the category Astronomy: it only organises files. Close the window with its ×, then click Next.

', 10, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Insert the image', '

Open CMS Content › Media again. In the window:

  1. Open the folder Astronomy. No images uploaded? Open sampledata › cassiopeia instead.
  2. Tick the checkbox on the Crab Nebula image (or on nasa1-640.jpg).
  3. Below, in Additional Data, type the Image Description (Alt Text): Crab Nebula.
  4. Click Insert Media.

The window closes and the image is in the text. Then click Next.

', 11, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Resize the image', '

Click the image: a blue frame with square handles appears.

Drag a corner handle until the image is about 600 pixels wide; a small label shows the size while you drag. Then click Next.

', 12, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Add a caption', '
  1. Right-click the image and choose Image.
  2. Tick Show caption and click Save.
  3. Below the image, type the caption: The Crab Nebula, a supernova remnant about 6,500 light-years from Earth.

Then click Next.

', 13, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Save, but stay', '

Click Save (not Save & Close): Joomla saves the article and you keep editing it.

', 14, 'bottom', '.view-article:has(#jform_alias[value=""]) #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'An image in a list', '
  1. Click the image, press → once and press Enter for a new line.
  2. Type Other notable deep-sky objects worth knowing about include: and press Enter.
  3. Click the bulleted list button and type two items: Andromeda Galaxy — the nearest large spiral galaxy to the Milky Way. and Orion Nebula — a bright stellar nursery visible to the naked eye under dark skies.
  4. Press Shift+Enter twice and insert the Orion Nebula image (or nasa2-640.jpg) with CMS Content › Media, alt text Orion Nebula.
  5. Press Shift+Enter, then Enter, and type a third item: Pleiades Cluster — a bright, easily visible open star cluster made up of hundreds of young blue stars. Press Enter twice to end the list.
  6. Right-click the Orion image, choose Image, set Width to 480, press Tab and click Save.

Then click Next.

', 15, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'An image in a table', '
  1. Click below the list and press Enter.
  2. Insert a table of 2 columns by 2 rows with the table button.
  3. In the first row, type Image and Fact.
  4. In the second row\'s first cell, insert the Crab Nebula image again, alt text Crab Nebula. Right-click it, choose Image and set Width to 240.
  5. In the second cell, type About 6,500 light-years from Earth, still expanding at over 1,500 km/s.
  6. Select both cells of the first row, right-click, choose Cell › Cell properties and set Cell type to Header cell.

Then click Next.

', 16, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'An image with a border', '
  1. Click below the table and press Enter.
  2. Type The Orion Nebula photo above was captured by this instrument:
  3. Insert the Hubble Space Telescope image (or nasa3-640.jpg), alt text The Hubble Space Telescope.
  4. Right-click it, choose Image, open the tab Advanced, set Border width to 4 and Border style to Double. Click Save.

Then click Next.

', 17, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save.

', 18, 'bottom', '.view-article:not(:has(#jform_alias[value=""])) #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Preview', '

Click Preview to see everything together: the image with its caption, the list, the table and the image with a border.

Close the preview, then click Next.

', 19, 'bottom', '.view-article .button-preview', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Save and close', '

Click Save & Close.

', 20, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-embedding-images-in-article-text'), 'Well done!', '

Your article Crab Nebula has four images in its text.

The images are stored apart from the article, in the media folder Astronomy: one image can be used in many places, and deleting the article does not delete its images.

', 21, 'bottom', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
